item.title: Volunteers of Indy Peace help gun violence victims recover and choose peace
item.description: Indy Peace is a program that provides gun violence victims in Indianapolis with support, de-escalation training, and job assistance to help them recover and reduce gun violence in the city. WISH-TV’s YATVAC campaign -- which stands for Youth Alternatives to Violence and Crime -- is dedicated to highlighting people and groups working to curb youth violence in our city.

item.title: WISH Tree’s successful toy drive brings Christmas cheer to children in need
item.description: WISH Tree, with the help of Fire Dawgs, collected hundreds of toys from Ed Martin, The National Bank of Indianapolis, and M/I Homes and delivered them to the Salvation Army for their Toys for Tots program.

item.title: Health Spotlight Special | Stay safe and healthy this holiday season with expert advice
item.description: WISH-TV partnered with Community Health Network for "Health Spotlight: A News 8 Town Hall Special" to discuss critical health issues in central Indiana, including prevention of slips and falls, heart health, flu season, and where to seek medical attention during the holidays.

item.title: Braun noncommittal on primary challenges to redistricting opponents
item.description: Gov. Mike Braun has not ruled out supporting challengers to senators who voted against new Congressional maps, though he stopped short of vowing to do so outright.

item.title: IPS to change immigration-related policies after Todd Rokita’s ICE lawsuit
item.description: Indianapolis Public Schools is changing its policies to address a lawsuit from Indiana Attorney General Todd Rokita, which claims the district impeded federal immigration enforcement, while the district maintains its commitment to the safety of its students.

item.title: Coach accused of sending sexually explicit images in private group’s sting
item.description: Levi Garrett, a 34-year-old Danville man, was charged with attempted dissemination of matter harmful to minors after, as part of a private group's sting, he sent sexually explicit messages and images of himself to a contact he believed was a 14-year-old.

item.title: 28-year-old charged with murder of mother in Terre Haute
item.description: A 28-year-old man, Lamar F. Whitlock, was arrested and preliminarily charged with murder and robbery in connection with the homicide of his mother, Renate Whitlock, in Terre Haute, Indiana.

item.title: Whiteland police relocate massive cocaine stash
item.description: Find out why the Whiteland Police Department had to relocate approximately 159 kilograms of cocaine, valued at $16 million, seized in June during a drug investigation at the Pilot Travel Center.
